statement: Fishing Efficiency is the primary fishing stat; it lets you catch bigger fish and later increases Multi-Fish.
Average Catch Time only matters later; from World 3 you want a faster one to raise 3D printer sample size.
Multi-Fish chance is the third key stat and massively increases overall gains per hour by catching multiple fish per cast.
Every fishing zone has a Tackle Box you can open; its Depth-o-meter shows catch chances per fish for your stats.
Each X color is a catch chance: green Goldfish; yellow Hermit Crabs; red jellyfish; purple Bloaches. Lures/twines/equipment change them.
Second zone (medium fish icon) adds four fish: Skelefish; Sand Shark; Manta Rays; Krakens.
Bottom bar of Tackle Box shows lure and line bonuses: Fishing Experience Bonus; Fishing Speed Bonus; Fishing Power.
For maximum efficiency use the Literal Elephant lure; lures drop from different mobs and some are quest-locked.
Literal Elephant lure requires completing the quest in the Up Down Zone in World 2.
Use the Golden Twine for good fishing experience bonus; speed bonus; power bonus; plus it raises Purple Depth for higher-end fish.
AFK Info tab shows catches per hour; experience per hour; and the Efficiency Requirement.
Green bar is catch chance; filling it to 100% stops wasted time and raises fish gained per hour.
Past 100% green you unlock the orange bar (1x/2x...); each level up raises quantity per drop; he has seen 20x and 30x.
Being between orange tiers gives no benefit so stop efficiency at the tier threshold and put the rest into AFK gain rate.
Exception: if you can reach the next tier such as 5x it is more effective than increasing AFK gain rate.
Helmet: Funny Hat from the Idle Skilling crossover event gives 6% Skill Efficiency.
If you skip the crossover event use Acorn Topper for a decent Skill EXP bonus.
Chest: Studded Hide crafted in Anvil Tab 2 gives 10% Fishing Efficiency.
Fishing Overalls crafted in Anvil Tab 1 give 12% more Fishing Efficiency.
Deep Sea Galoshes crafted in Anvil Tab 4 give 35% Skill Efficiency.
Anglers Boots from Anvil Tab 2 give 20% Fishing Efficiency; still craft the Tab 4 boots as soon as possible.
Start with Persephone's Bouquet from the Dungeon Flurbo Shop for 15% skill AFK gain rate.
Fuscismatia pendant gives +30 Purple Depth to catch Krakens or Bloaches more often.
Fish Head Pendant from the Flurbo Shop gives more fishing EXP gain and purple depth benefit.
Any of the three pendants is viable depending on what you want.
Use two Serrated Rex Rings for 8% Skill Efficiency each; crafted from a Baba Yaga recipe plus the Flurbo Shop Rex Ring.
On the specials tab put strength on premium items; more strength means more fishing efficiency.
Keychains: All AFK Gain Rate or Strength / %Strength are good; also All Skill Speed or All Stats.
Watermelon Pendants have a chance for Fishing EXP gain; he does not have one.
Upgrading the level or quality of your fishing rod is one of the best upgrades.
Rod materials are expensive; do not over-level your rod since each has a level requirement.
Fishing Power from the rod is one of the most important stats for fishing efficiency.
Use Golden Ribs for more Fishing Efficiency.
Golden Ham gives more Skill EXP; Slurpin Herm gives more Fishing Speed.
Foods are consumed quickly; decide whether to use them for regular fishing or save them for raising printer sample size.
Play a strength-based class like Barbarian; Squire also works but Barbarian has all the fishing talents.
Tab 1 priority one: Brute Efficiency for more total efficiency.
Tab 1 second: Idle Skilling for more skill AFK gain rate.
Tab 1 third: Fist of Rage for more maximum strength; strength means more fishing efficiency.
Everything else on Tab 1 is optional; useful if you need more star talent points.
Tab 2 first priority: Absolute Unit for more base strength.
Second: Firmly Grasp It for base strength; it is an active skill that must be on the skill bar.
Third: 'STR'ess Tested Garb for strength from equipment; low conversion rate so not top priority.
Fourth: Haungry for Gold for more benefit from golden food such as Golden Ribs.
Lastly Tempestuous Emotions for more EXP gain for all skills.
Tab 3 first priorities are the four at the bottom in no particular order; start with Worming Undercover.
Worming Undercover is an active skill for the action bar that instantly catches fish while you play.
Bobbin' Bobbers gives fishing power based on your fishing minigame high score; only invest points up to your high score.
All Fish Diet for fishing EXP; Catching Some ZZZ's for fishing AFK gain rate; STR Summore for more Fist of Rage points.
Strongest Statues boosts the Oceanman Statue from World 1 for more Fishing Power.
Fistful of Obol gives strength from obols but a very low amount; not a first priority.
If you need more points in Tab 2 use Back to the Basics; everything else on that tab is optional.
Tab 4 first priority: Symbols of Beyond.
Symbols of Beyond gives free levels to every talent with at least one point; he gets eight.
Next: Overblown Testosterone for strength and more max talent levels in Fist of Rage.
Skill Strengthen gives more skill efficiency from strength and a small strength bonus.
Rest of Tab 4 is optional; he likes points in Cooking skills.
The Family Guy boosts family bonuses but many are not great and give little stats.
Star talents: Tick Tock first for AFK gain rate.
Toilet Paper Postage for skill efficiency from stamps; depends on stamp levels so may not be worth it.
Will of the Eldest gives a small strength bonus.
Star Tab 2: Super Source for base efficiency; Action Frenzy for skill speed in all skills.
Frothy Malk gives a boost to potions and foods.
He likes Telekinetic Storage; Printer Sampling; and Shrine Architect but that is optional personal choice.
Start with Pie Seas star sign for fishing efficiency and multi-fish odds.
Options after: The OG Skiller for skill AFK gain rate and prowess; or The Big Comatose for AFK gain rate.
Hydron tab: Comatose Major for skill AFK gain rate; or Strandissi for percentage base strength.
Card setup starts with Chaotic Troll for all skill efficiency.
Then Amarok for skill AFK gain rate and the Bunny from Hard Resources for AFK gain rate.
Fishing cards: Skelefish for total fishing efficiency; Shark for fishing speed; Kraken for fishing AFK gain rate.
Manta Ray gives fishing EXP if wanted but he prefers Bloach for AFK gain rate.
Hermit Crab for fishing efficiency and Jellyfish for fishing EXP.
Card set bonus: use Easy Resources for skill efficiency; Hard Resources for AFK gain rate if you have enough efficiency.
Stamps: Fishing Rod Stamp for base efficiency.
FishHead Stamp for fishing EXP; Bag o Heads for carry capacity; Holy Mackerel for multi-fish chance.
Tab 1 stamps: Fist Stamp and Violent Stamp for base strength.
Statues: Feasty Statue for food effect and Oceanman Statue for fishing power.
Get the Golden Statues bonus to share statues across all characters.
Alchemy bubble Roid Ragin gives more total strength.
Warriors Rule doubles orange passive bubbles but only works while online on a Warrior class; not when AFK on Shaman.
Reely Smart gives more fishing EXP gain.
Sploosh is a large bubble that must be equipped and gives more Multi-Fish.
Stronk Tools gives more skilling power from the fishing rod.
MultOrange gives another multiplier to certain bubbles.
Dreams of IronFish gives fishing AFK gain rate but requires a higher-end anvil material.
Shimmeron boosts golden food effects but requires a higher anvil material.
Prowesessary reduces efficiency needed to reach the next quantity-per-drop tier on the orange bar.
Etruscan Lager vial gives more overall fishing efficiency.
Etruscan Lager needs quite a few minerals from the Mamooth in World 3.
Post Office: Sealed Fish Heads box gives fishing efficiency; prowess effect; and fishing AFK gain rate.
Myriad Crate for base all stats; all efficiency; all-skill EXP; and Utilitarian Capsule with spare boxes.
Utilitarian Capsule gives more printer sample size.
Obols: grab fishing power obols which give a small strength bonus; otherwise use Strength obols.
Strength from obols is small so avoid putting many points into Fistful of Obol.
Prayer Obelisk: Skilled Dimwit gives a huge skill efficiency bonus at the cost of EXP gain.
Balance of Proficiency is the opposite: more EXP gain at the cost of skill efficiency.
If leveling on Maestro grab Unending Energy for skill EXP; check back a couple times a day.
Royal Sampler gives another bonus to printer sampling size.
Royal Sampler adds an EXP gain penalty; removing it requires deleting all current samples.
Dinner Menu: raise three meals; Corn for overall skill efficiency.
Rice ball for skill efficiency and leek for large skilling prowessary bonus.
Certified Stamp Book doubles all stamp bonuses.
My First Chemistry Set doubles alchemy vial bonuses.
Emerald Navette gives skill efficiency and action speed; applies twice if all green jewels are activated.
Black Diamond Rhinestone raises dinner menu meal bonuses by about 24%.
Red chips: one for total skilling efficiency and another giving 250 base efficiency for all skills.
Orange chips double misc bonus from trophy; higher keychain slot; and pendant; important for fishing depth bonuses and AFK gain.
Two gray chips each double a bonus from a card slot.
Gray chips work well with Chaotic Troll (all skill efficiency) and Amarok (all-skill AFK gain rate) at the same time.
Maestro's Right Hand of Action gives a very large skill efficiency bonus if Maestro's skill level is higher than other characters.
His Maestro fishing is 41 below his Barbarian so no 75% bonus; leveling Maestro to 51-52 fishing would give it.
